devButtons.label: Preview Normal mode with no sabotage active

sabotages.name: Turbo Mode
sabotages.caption: The next lap is arriving a little faster.
sabotages.effect: Moving-block speed increases to ×1.7 for 5 seconds.

sabotages.name: Drunk Block
sabotages.caption: That block has found a very wobbly rhythm.
sabotages.effect: Alternates between ×0.25–0.45 stumbles and ×1.55–1.9 lurches, holding each beat for 0.55–0.70 seconds.

sabotages.name: Slow-to-Dart
sabotages.caption: Easy… easy… now!
sabotages.effect: Creeps at ×0.3 for 0.78 seconds, then lunges at ×2.5 on a 1.4-second cycle.

sabotages.name: Gravity Slingshot
sabotages.caption: The stack centre is a launch point.
sabotages.effect: The mover whips up to ×2.1 speed over the tower centre and returns to normal near the walls.

sabotages.name: Portal Walls
sabotages.caption: The edges are not the end of the road.
sabotages.effect: For the next 3 drops (up to 8 seconds), the mover wraps through open side portals instead of bouncing.

sabotages.name: The Rollercoaster
sabotages.caption: Mind the air gap, darling.
sabotages.effect: The mover bobs from the landing line up to 45 px above it; no hidden sideways drift.

sabotages.name: Earthquake
sabotages.caption: The foundations have a few objections.
sabotages.effect: The playfield trembles by up to 8 px sideways and 3 px vertically for 5 seconds; block physics stay unchanged.

sabotages.name: The Pisa Tilt
sabotages.caption: Architecture is subjective, really.
sabotages.effect: The view eases into a gentle sway of up to 16° for 5 seconds.

sabotages.name: Spotlight
sabotages.caption: One corner of the stage is under observation.
sabotages.effect: Blacks out the whole field, leaving only a narrow, steady beam on one edge of the tower.

sabotages.name: Peekaboo
sabotages.caption: Now you see it… now you don’t.
sabotages.effect: The mover appears for 0.35 seconds, fades over 40 ms, then stays hidden for 0.35 seconds.

sabotages.name: Macro Zoom
sabotages.caption: Extreme close-up. Don’t blink.
sabotages.effect: A 1.85× view locks onto the top platform; wall rebounds can leave the frame.

sabotages.name: The Shell Game
sabotages.caption: Follow the cracked block.
sabotages.effect: A decoy travels in the opposite direction; a small crack marks the real mover.

sabotages.name: The Accordion
sabotages.caption: Wide, narrow, wide again.
sabotages.effect: Breathes between 45% and 100% of the supporting tower width on a 0.8-second cycle.

sabotages.name: Crumble
sabotages.caption: Perfects keep the stone intact.
sabotages.effect: For the next 3 drops (up to 8 seconds), perfects do not crumble; other landings lose up to 5 px from each edge.

sabotages.name: Chat Bribe: Superglue
sabotages.caption: Chat took pity… or is setting up a bigger fall.
sabotages.effect: The next 3 drops (up to 8 seconds) get a 14 px perfect window.

sabotages.name: Drafting Calipers
sabotages.caption: The drafting arms have closed in.
sabotages.effect: For the next 3 drops (up to 8 seconds), rebounds are limited to 38 px beyond the tower edges.

normal.desc: Baseline: ordinary speed, width, camera, and placement rules; no sabotage is active.
normal.name: No sabotage active
normal.caption: First vote at 8s, then every 10s (7s from height 25). Keep stacking.
normal.feedback: Normal mode: no sabotage is active. Use manual Drop to establish a baseline, or simulate a clean landing.
normal.panel: Local and scoreless—no votes or multiplayer messages. The sample starts lined up for a quick manual drop. Motion follows your system preference. Exit with Menu or Esc.
normal.hint: Tap the stage or press Space to test-drop
